instructionA: Speak in clear, warm, curious English like a science-program host. Keep the pace conversational, respond naturally to the previous turn, and avoid promotional delivery. Treat punctuation only as phrasing guidance.
instructionB: Speak in calm, informed, approachable English like a knowledgeable science-podcast guest. Use a measured conversational pace, articulate dates, names, model names, and abbreviations clearly, and pause lightly around key ideas without sounding theatrical, solemn, or promotional. Treat punctuation only as phrasing guidance.
instructionNarrator: Speak in clear, engaging English like a science-podcast storyteller. Begin with restrained curiosity, keep technical explanations steady and precise, and avoid a heavy documentary-announcer tone. Treat punctuation only as phrasing guidance.
instructionSummary: Continue naturally from the preceding explanation and close with concise, calm English. Slow only slightly at the end; do not announce that this is a summary or force an inspirational conclusion.
